metadata.description: Identity of this resolved serving instance and its producer.

instance_id.description: Canonical lowercase UUIDv4, created once per resolved serving instance; every process of one launch reads the same ID.

producer.description: The executable that resolved this manifest.

build_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the installed bc-serve executable (64 lowercase hex).

contract_version.description: Contract version; exactly 1, matching the apiVersion suffix.

content_digest.description: `sha256:` + JCS SHA-256 of the manifest with this member removed (spec §8).

spec.description: The resolved serving configuration. `experiment` is present only when the profile is `lab`.

intent.description: What the operator asked for: model, layout and service policy.

model.description: Model container path the engine loads (`--model`).

objective.description: Service objective that selects calibration and derivations.

retention.description: Whether finished sessions' prefix state is kept for reuse.

quality.description: Numerical quality policy: baseline, or strict reference-equivalent paths.

facts.description: Detected host and GPU facts the resolution used.

cgroup_limits.description: Memory limits of each enclosing cgroup, innermost first.

room_mib.description: Room left under that cgroup's limit, MiB.

pin_cap_mib.description: amdgpu pinned-memory cap, MiB; null when the driver sets none.

calibration.description: Selected calibrated parameters, each with its evidence.

key.description: Calibrated parameter; its value's type is fixed per key (contract `calibration_key` table).

value.description: The parameter's value: an unsigned integer, a string or a boolean, as its key requires.

evidence.description: Where the evidence for this value is recorded.

pool_mib.description: Pinned host pool for experts and the KV tier, MiB (`--host-pool-mib`).

reserve_mib.description: Host memory held back for the system, MiB (`--host-headroom-mib`).

checkpoint_slots.description: Prefix checkpoint slots (`--checkpoint-slots`), derived from the measured plan: present when `plan.state` is `measured`, absent when it is `unmeasured`.

handoff.description: The one shared remote-MoE handoff configuration. Present exactly when `processes.helpers` is not empty (amendment 12).

transport.description: Shared-memory transport between the engine and helpers.

shm.description: POSIX shared-memory name of the handoff segment.

max_rows.description: Largest row batch a request carries.

small_rows.description: Row count at or below which a request uses a small lane.

gemv_large_rows.description: Row count from which helpers use the large GEMV path.

skip_owned.description: The engine skips experts a helper owns.

strategy.description: Owner assignment: `tail` (the tail helper takes the cold end) or `roundrobin`.

heat_file.description: Expert heat file the owner map is planned from.

live_policy.description: Live expert placement from the runtime heat map (RHP). Present: the helper runs the policy; absent: no policy thread. Every member is explicit (no defaults); needs one engine rank and a live histogram file, and excludes `experiment.placement.forced`.

effect_gate.description: A move must pass the measured effect gate before it stays.

accept_unwatermarked_heat.description: Accept a histogram file heat source that carries no coherent observation watermark.

max_moves.description: Most experts one policy epoch may move.

max_moved_bytes.description: Most device bytes one policy epoch may move.

min_residency_ns.description: Shortest time an expert stays where a move put it, ns.

max_heat_age_ns.description: Oldest heat observation the policy accepts, ns.

min_samples.description: Fewest observations an expert needs before it can move.

abort_cooldown_ns.description: Quiet time after an aborted move, ns.

learned_eligibility_ttl_ns.description: How long a learned eligibility answer is trusted, ns.

effect_min_quiet_windows.description: Quiet windows the effect gate needs before it accepts a move.

effect_revert_ttl_ns.description: How long a move can be reverted by the effect gate, ns.

margin_ppm.description: Relative heat gain a move must show, ppm (0 < margin < 1).

half_life_observations_milli.description: Heat decay half-life in observations, thousandths.

protected_layers.description: Model-global layer ids the policy never moves, strictly ascending; empty means none.

histogram_file.description: Live expert histogram file; null disables it.

gpus.description: Engine GPU addresses, in rank order.

headroom_mib.description: VRAM left unclaimed on every engine card, MiB (`--gpu-headroom-mib`; amendment 11).

tp_wire.description: Cross-rank all-reduce payload (`--tp-wire`; amendment 11): `exact`, or `wht6`, a lossy 6-bit transform.

no_prefix_cache.description: Present means prefix caching is disabled (`--no-prefix-cache`; amendment 11). Not the host KV tier size (`resources.host.kv_mib`, `--prefix-cache-mib`): that tier stays configurable with caching on.

sampling.description: Default sampling for requests that set none (amendment 13). Every member is optional and binds to one engine flag; an absent member leaves the engine's own default.

dry_base.description: Engine flag `--dry-base` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (F).

dry_multiplier.description: Engine flag `--dry-multiplier` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (F).

dry_sequence_breakers.description: Engine flag `--dry-sequence-breakers` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (JSON).

frequency_penalty.description: Engine flag `--frequency-penalty` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (F).

generation_config.description: Engine flag `--generation-config` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (PATH).

min_p.description: Engine flag `--min-p` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (F).

presence_penalty.description: Engine flag `--presence-penalty` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (F).

repetition_penalty.description: Engine flag `--repetition-penalty` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (F).

temp.description: Engine flag `--temp` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (F).

top_p.description: Engine flag `--top-p` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (F).

typical_p.description: Engine flag `--typical-p` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (F).

xtc_probability.description: Engine flag `--xtc-probability` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (F).

xtc_threshold.description: Engine flag `--xtc-threshold` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (F).

limits.description: HTTP server identity, transport and request limits (amendment 13). Every member is optional and binds to one engine flag; an absent member leaves the engine's own default.

api_key.description: Engine flag `--api-key` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (KEY).

host.description: Engine flag `--host` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (ADDR).

keep_alive_timeout.description: Engine flag `--keep-alive-timeout` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (S).

no_cors.description: Engine flag `--no-cors` (amendment 13). Present means the flag is given.

read_timeout.description: Engine flag `--read-timeout` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (S).

retry_after.description: Engine flag `--retry-after` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (S).

served_model_name.description: Engine flag `--served-model-name` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (NAME).

write_timeout.description: Engine flag `--write-timeout` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (S).

chat.description: Chat template and reasoning behaviour (amendment 13). Every member is optional and binds to one engine flag; an absent member leaves the engine's own default.

chat_template_kwargs.description: Engine flag `--chat-template-kwargs` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (JSON).

override_chat_template.description: Engine flag `--override-chat-template` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (PATH).

reasoning_effort.description: Engine flag `--reasoning-effort` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (S).

reasoning_effort_map.description: Engine flag `--reasoning-effort-map` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (MAP).

reasoning_format.description: Engine flag `--reasoning-format` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (MODE).

lora.description: LoRA adapters and control vectors (amendment 13). Every member is optional and binds to one engine flag; an absent member leaves the engine's own default.

control_vector.description: Engine flag `--control-vector` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (MODE).

lora_dir.description: Engine flag `--lora-dir` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (DIR).

lora_target_modules.description: Engine flag `--lora-target-modules` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (LIST).

max_lora_rank.description: Engine flag `--max-lora-rank` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (R).

vision.description: Image and video input limits and placement (amendment 13). Every member is optional and binds to one engine flag; an absent member leaves the engine's own default.

video_fps.description: Engine flag `--video-fps` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (F).

vision_tower_placement.description: Engine flag `--vision-tower-placement` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (WHERE).

tuning.description: Prefill, tensor-parallel, expert, draft and cache tuning (amendment 13). Every member is optional and binds to one engine flag; an absent member leaves the engine's own default.

attn_prefill_fp8.description: Engine flag `--attn-prefill-fp8` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (MODE).

busy_prefill_chunk.description: Engine flag `--busy-prefill-chunk` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (MODE).

checkpoint_policy.description: Engine flag `--checkpoint-policy` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (NAME).

draft_coupling.description: Engine flag `--draft-coupling` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (MODE).

draft_expert_placement.description: Engine flag `--draft-expert-placement` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (PLACEMENT).

draft_model.description: Engine flag `--draft-model` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (PATH).

draft_window.description: Engine flag `--draft-window` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (MODE).

embedding_placement.description: Engine flag `--embedding-placement` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (WHERE).

expert_pin_top.description: Engine flag `--expert-pin-top` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (F).

expert_profile.description: Engine flag `--expert-profile` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (FILE).

expert_stats.description: Engine flag `--expert-stats` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (FILE).

live.description: Engine flag `--live` (amendment 13). Present means the flag is given.

p2p.description: Engine flag `--p2p` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (MODE).

prefix_cache_ttl.description: Engine flag `--prefix-cache-ttl` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (S).

state_cache_dtype.description: Engine flag `--state-cache-dtype` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (T).

tp_attn_split.description: Engine flag `--tp-attn-split` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (MODE).

weight_prefetch.description: Engine flag `--weight-prefetch` (amendment 13). Value text as the flag takes it (MODE).

weights_disk_tier.description: Engine flag `--weights-disk-tier` (amendment 13). Present means the flag is given.

diagnostics.description: Debug switches that change what the engine does (amendment 13). Every member is optional and binds to one engine flag; an absent member leaves the engine's own default.

debug_accept_reference_kernels.description: Engine flag `--debug-accept-reference-kernels` (amendment 13). Present means the flag is given.

debug_placement.description: Engine flag `--debug-placement` (amendment 13). Present means the flag is given.

kernels.description: Engine-process kernel switches that were environment variables (amendment 14). Every member is optional; an absent member leaves the kernel's own default. The engine sets the matching variable from the member at start (rad0009).

moe_native.description: Native w4nl64 MoE inner loop in the engine process (`R3_MOE_NATIVE`; an unset engine reads off).

moe_fp16.description: Grouped MoE GEMM widens E4M3 operands to f16 in the engine process (`R3_MOE_FP16`).

moe_ahalf.description: Grouped MoE GEMM stages its activation tile as half in the engine process (`R3_MOE_AHALF`).

gfx12_moe_gemv.description: gfx12 fp8a8 MoE decode GEMV on the packed-f16 form (`BC_GFX12_MOE_GEMV`).

all_reduce_wire4.description: 4-bit cross-card all-reduce wire at M >= 512 (`R3_AR_WIRE4`; experimental, costs quality).

dec11.description: gfx11 MXFP4 decode GEMV form (`R3_DEC11`; experimental).

fuse_stage.description: Stage a decode-sized step (at most 16 rows) in the publish kernel itself (`R3_MOE_WORKER_FUSESTAGE`; amendment 15).

helper_common.description: Settings shared by every helper; per-role and lab patches apply on top (spec §2.2). Present exactly when `processes.helpers` is not empty (amendment 12).

helpers.description: Helper processes, ordered helper0, helper1, ...; a helper's index is its position. Empty for an engine-only configuration (amendment 12).

vram_budget_mib.description: VRAM the helper may use, MiB.

formats.description: Expert weight formats the helper serves.

rows_kernel.description: The architecture requires the rows kernel.

plan.description: Measured and planned state the engine and helpers verify at start-up.

owner_map.description: Initial expert ownership; the live mailbox epochs own later placement (spec §4).

owner_map_sha256.description: Digest of all helpers' owned sets in helper order (spec §4).

helpers.description: Owned sets, aligned by index with `processes.helpers`; empty exactly when there are no helpers.

owned_sha256.description: Digest of this helper's owned set (spec §4).

bytes.description: Device bytes of the owned experts.

experts.description: Owned `[layer, expert]` pairs in selection order.

state.description: `measured`: `engine_memory` is present and every start path accepts the manifest. `unmeasured`: the owner map and settings only, for the one measuring start that produces the plan (`engine_memory` absent); every serving start refuses it.

engine_memory.description: The engine's measured memory plan and its cache identity (spec §5).

expected.description: The measured plan the live plan is checked against (spec §5.2).

experiment.description: Lab-only experiments; forbidden when the profile is `production`.

forced.description: The forced placement schedule (RHP11 validation): one proposal per step, in order, the whole list `repeat` times. Required by mode `forced_churn`, forbidden by `observe`.

repeat.description: How many times the step list is issued.

kind.description: `move` one expert to `destination`; `swap` two named experts; `auto_swap` the first eligible distinct pair, excluding the previous transaction (`a_layer`, `a_expert` carry its x, y).

a_layer.description: Layer of the first expert (for `auto_swap`, x).

b_layer.description: Layer of the second expert of a `swap`.

epoch_cycle_s.description: Helper 0 runs a no-op placement epoch cycle (close, drain, recommit the same placement, reopen) every this many seconds of burst (RHP11 validation); absent: off.

shape.description: Lab overlay of helper settings, applied after the per-role patches.

settings.description: Partial helper settings for that role.

capture_file.description: Lane capture file; null disables capture.

test_stop_at.description: Test hook stop point; null disables it.

plugin_override.description: Plugin library to load instead; null keeps the configured one.

engine.description: Lab-only engine diagnostics (amendment 11): flags the engine takes that are not serving configuration. Forbidden by the `production` profile with the rest of `spec.experiment`.

debug_selection.description: Present means the engine prints its selection table (`--debug-selection`).

deterministic.description: Present pins placement to the plan the loader made (`--deterministic`).

kv_resident.description: Stream the sparse attention group's KV from host memory, resident tokens (`--kv-resident`).

provenance.description: Map from a JSON Pointer to the record of where that value (and its descendants) came from; the root "" record is required (spec §7).

additionalProperties.description: Provenance of the value at the key's JSON Pointer.

origin.description: Input layer that set the value.

source.description: Human-readable source: file and key, detector or derivation.

class.description: Kind of value: operator policy, detected fact, derived, tuned (calibrated) or diagnostic.

lifecycle.description: When the value may change: only at start-up, at a step boundary, or live.

inputs.description: JSON Pointers of the values this one was derived from.

uint.description: Unsigned integer within I-JSON's safe range.

positive.description: Positive integer within I-JSON's safe range.

jsonPointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer; "" is the root.

power_save.description: Let the helper idle its GPU between requests.

small_lanes.description: Up to four sorted small-lane row thresholds.

rows.description: Use the rows kernel by policy (active also when the architecture requires it).

rows_small.description: Use the rows kernel for small lanes.

enabled.description: Combine expert outputs on the helper.

min_rows.description: Fewest rows a combine is used for.

moe_long_rows.description: Row count from which the long-rows MoE kernel is used.

fuseroute.description: Fuse routing into the MoE kernel.

balance.description: Balance load across helpers by speed.

balance_speeds_milli.description: Per-helper relative speed in thousandths (1000 = 1.0); one value per helper, only when balance is true.

helperPatch.description: A partial `helperCommon`: each present group is a nonempty partial field map (spec §2.2).

power_save.description: Let the helper idle its GPU between requests.

small_lanes.description: Up to four sorted small-lane row thresholds.

rows.description: Use the rows kernel by policy (active also when the architecture requires it).

rows_small.description: Use the rows kernel for small lanes.

enabled.description: Combine expert outputs on the helper.

min_rows.description: Fewest rows a combine is used for.

moe_long_rows.description: Row count from which the long-rows MoE kernel is used.

fuseroute.description: Fuse routing into the MoE kernel.

balance.description: Balance load across helpers by speed.

balance_speeds_milli.description: Per-helper relative speed in thousandths (1000 = 1.0); one value per helper, only when balance is true.

kv.description: KV share before MiB rounding (live; never an admission input).

kv_resolved.description: Common KV budget after the staging split and MiB rounding (live; spec §5.2).

expert_floor.description: Expert residency the host pool cannot hold (stable).

kv_ceiling.description: KV for every session at full length (stable).
